description: Review exact task bindings, full typed answers and nested result snapshots.

lesson.applicability: Existing exact request/answer boundaries with a declared type and task-binding contract.
lesson.cause: Partial comparison, bool/int equality and shared mutable aliases can discard parts of the declared answer contract.
lesson.correction: Compare every declared answer field using the existing typed comparison, check the complete request binding and snapshot nested result values.
lesson.counterexample: The retained Hodge controls change the task binding, substitute true for an integer and mutate nested input after evaluation.
lesson.evidence_excerpt:
At an existing exact contract boundary, compare the complete typed answer and its
complete task binding, then snapshot nested result data.
lesson.exceptions: Do not invent a universal JSON canonicalization profile, prescribe unrelated parser limits, claim authentication from a hash or infer general correctness from a finite match.
lesson.failed_claim: Matching a selected field or a Python-equal value is sufficient to accept a submitted exact answer.

response: Report a concrete mismatch or alias witness and repair the existing comparison/snapshot owner; preserve the declared encoding and unaffected behavior.
